items.text: One day after DNP (ankle/rest), Bengals listed WR Ja'Marr Chase as a full participant in Thursday practice. Rapoport noted he should be ok.
items.why: Maintenance/rest DNP Wednesday; returned full Thursday with no significant concern.
items.implication: Expected to play vs Titans; maintain WR1 usage.

items.text: For the second straight day, Ravens listed QB Lamar Jackson as a full participant at practice. Rapoport earlier confirmed he is poised to return vs Bills after missing three games with ankle injury.
items.why: Full practices Wednesday and Thursday after ankle sprain; Rapoport sources say expected to play and near 100%.
items.implication: Unlocks Ravens offense ceiling; major boost for pass-catchers and Henry.
items.opportunity: Increased passing volume, red-zone, and two-minute usage for skill players.

items.text: After limited Wednesday, Patriots listed WR AJ Brown as non-participant Thursday due to ankle and knee injuries. Rapoport: knee flared up, not spotted, status for Sunday up in the air.
items.why: Ankle ongoing plus new knee flare; sources confirm not practicing, TBD Sunday vs Dolphins.
items.implication: Game-time or possible sit; monitor Friday designation. Pop Douglas led drills.
items.opportunity: If OUT, targets to secondary WRs/TEs; if IN, still volume but efficiency risk.

items.text: Zay Flowers is my WR5 this week. Lamar Jackson is expected back, and I LOVE what that means for Flowers.
items.why: Lamar return unlocks efficiency (Flowers YPRR leader); track-meet Bills matchup.
items.implication: Strong WR1/2 start; ceiling spike with Jackson.

items.text: Seahawks officially designated RB Jadarian Price for return to practice. Schefter confirmed the designation.
items.why: Officially designated; can practice and potentially activate soon.
items.implication: Crowds SEA backfield further; monitor for role/snaps vs current backs. Lineup question in crowded BF per prior notes.
items.opportunity: Potential carries/routes if elevated; handcuff value rises short-term.

items.text: Jaylen Waddle (chest aggravation) DNP Wednesday, returned limited Thursday. Status TBD vs Chiefs; Rapoport earlier said determined by practice.
items.why: Aggravated prior chest on reverse Week 7; limited return keeps door open but uncertain.
items.implication: Questionable; fade per Berry even if plays. Sutton/Mims upside if out.
items.opportunity: If OUT, increased targets for Courtland Sutton and Marvin Mims.

items.text: Lions RB Jahmyr Gibbs (shoulder) and WR Amon-Ra St. Brown (ankle) listed as non-participants at Wednesday practice.
items.why: Gibbs shoulder, St. Brown ankle (Campbell expected Wed rest possible); monitor rest of week vs Vikings.
items.implication: Availability risk for Week 8; if limited/out, Montgomery/Williams/LaPorta upside.
items.opportunity: If OUT, clear path for David Montgomery carries and Jameson Williams/LaPorta targets.

items.text: “I do think it’s time to move on and move forward with Jonah Coleman” — Evan Silva and Adam Levitan discuss DEN backfield and Coleman’s return (led snaps/touches in first game back, Payton wants more).
items.why: Coleman 50% snaps/11 touches on return (4.9 YPC season); Payton: get him more touches. Dobbins/Harvey inefficient (3.4/3.6 YPC).
items.implication: Coleman emerging lead; waiver priority/must-roster. Downgrade pure Dobbins/Harvey standalone.
items.opportunity: Early-down/goal-line expansion for Coleman; reverse prior handcuff lean.

items.text: Truly special stuff from Jaxon Smith-Njigba. Loses Klint Kubiak. Not many other dynamic threats. DCs shading coverage. Stadium knows where ball going. Doesn't matter. JSN ripping off 9 more actual fantasy points than his opportunity would imply.
items.why: Data shows massive FP overperformance vs opportunity share despite lost OC and heavy coverage.
items.implication: Sustainable elite efficiency; strong WR1 ROS even in tougher spots.
items.opportunity: High YPRR/routes/targets conversion; continue forcing volume.

items.text: Jaylen Waddle is on my HATE list this week. The production hasn’t been there, and the Chiefs have allowed just ONE touchdown to an opposing WR all season (JSN).
items.why: Poor recent production + elite KC WR defense (1 TD allowed all year).
items.implication: Sit/fade even if active; tough matchup.
items.opportunity: Limited routes/targets expected vs tough secondary; chest injury adds risk (DNP Wed, limited Thu).

items.text: RB Loves include Derrick Henry @ BUF (RB6) and Chase Brown vs TEN (RB8). Favorable run defenses and TD equity.
items.why: Henry history vs BUF + Lamar unlock; Brown TD luck due vs soft TEN run D.
items.implication: Strong RB2/flex starts with volume upside.
items.opportunity: Carries, goal-line, possible receiving for Brown; Henry volume with Jackson.

items.text: RB Hates: Saquon Barkley @ WSH (RB20), Omarion Hampton @ LAR (RB34). Usage concerns for Barkley; Hampton still seeking real role. Dameon Pierce to IR backdrop.
items.why: Barkley usage dip/concerns; Hampton limited role vs tough LAR; Pierce IR context.
items.implication: Fade/sit; look elsewhere for RB volume.
items.opportunity: Reduced snaps/carries risk for Barkley; Hampton low opportunity.

items.text: In the 2 games since Caleb Williams returned, Colston Loveland averaging 30% target share and 19.2 PPG. Leads position in utilization; top-5 TE both weeks.
items.why: 30% targets + elite utilization post-Williams return; consistent top-5 finishes.
items.implication: Must-start TE1; buy into role with Caleb.
items.opportunity: High target share, routes, red-zone in Bears offense.

items.text: Pat Thorman’s Week 8 rankings are live on ETR (snaps/pace focused); updates Friday/Sunday.
items.why: ETR priority rankings posted; opportunity/snap weighted.
items.implication: Use for start/sit and ROS context (paywalled details).
